rules: Repository status is archived/research-complete; a generic next-task request must not create a new implementation or research lane.
Only an explicit owner decision to unarchive/reopen TracePixel may establish new roadmap authority.
Do not mutate, relabel, overwrite or rerun frozen scored/negative evidence merely to improve the recorded result.
No new provider/model run is authorized by the archived lane.
G8 issue #119 remains closed with owner REJECT + PIVOT; do not reopen humanoid direct-authoring expansion.
P11-X0 and P11-X1 remain retained useful research; P11-X2+ remain cancelled as standalone-product work.
P12 precision-edit research is terminated before execution; no R1/R2 provider experiment is required to justify keeping the repository alive.
TracePixel is not the owner of an Asset Studio, showroom, general asset library, provider marketplace or broad game-sprite production product; that responsibility belongs to Trace2D issue #318.
Do not duplicate Trace2D SPP0-SPP5 generic processing, extraction, QA/repair, import or provider-neutral generation orchestration.
TracePixel-direct remains historical research infrastructure, not a privileged production generator.
Deterministic QA green never implies aesthetic/product PASS; subjective quality remains perceptual/human.
Do not implement an autonomous aesthetic-score-until-threshold regeneration loop.
Future Trace2D reuse should upstream only the smallest evidence-backed historical technique needed by a concrete Trace2D workload rather than reopening TracePixel by default.
Explicitly requested archival maintenance for security, reproducibility, accessibility or evidence preservation is allowed but must not become feature development.
